text:
isabel: Quick kickoff for Sparks StarterKit  goal: three short hands-on tutorials (local dev, containerize, deploy to Dedicated), a compact benchmark post (latency/cost tradeoffs), a 30-min webinar, and a tiny demo repo with a 1-click deploy. Need owners for repo, benchmark, landing + funnel, copy, and tracking.

tom: I can own the repo + demo app. plan: tiny Flask app + static client, route to a pinned model with streaming. repo layout: /sparks-starterkit/{1-local,2-docker,3-dedicated}/bench. will add GH Actions and a simple playground button.

kevin: I'll draft the benchmark narrative. suggest we compare three configs: hosted small model, quantized open model, and Dedicated standard instance. metrics: p95 latency, cost/1k tokens, tokens/sec, and memory footprint. will add reproducible scripts.

trisha: I'll take landing + webinar funnel. recommend open repo + gated webinar RSVP (email capture) so we get leads but still drive immediate repo visits in thank-you email. funnel: landing -> RSVP modal -> immediate repo link -> 3-email drip (tutorial, bench, webinar reminder).

isabel: @tom include a GIF for social; @kevin please keep bench scripts lightweight so folks can run locally. @trisha capture UTMs and pass to ops for HubSpot mapping.

ops-bot: scheduled: social-tease queued for 2024-05-10T14:00:00Z.

tom: GIF plan: 8-10s loop showing prompt -> streaming response -> latency counter overlay. i'll export mp4 + gif. need thumbnail from design by Tue.

kevin: bench plan (short): dataset = 250 short chat turns; runs = 10 cold starts + 30 simulated sessions; outputs = table + small chart + summary paragraph. will PR to /bench branch by Wed EOD.

trisha: inbound payload example for ops (HubSpot bridge):
```
POST /webhooks/lead
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "email": "dev@example.com",
  "name": "Dev Example",
  "company": "Example Co",
  "role": "Engineer",
  "source": "sparks_starterkit_landing",
  "utm_campaign": "sparks_launch_may",
  "interests": ["starterkit","dedicated"]
}
```
Please map utm_campaign -> campaign and tag interests.

isabel: timeline proposal:
- Mon: repo skeleton + hero copy (tom + rachel)
- Tue: bench harness PR (kevin) + GIF draft (tom)
- Wed: landing + tracking live (trisha + ops)
- Thu: publish tutorial #1 + social tease
- Fri: webinar + publish bench post

trisha: can shift webinar to next week if bench needs more time. final ask: drop a 1-line status in the Notion checklist by EOD. i'll run a 15-min sync tomorrow 9:30am PT. thanks all :sparkles:
